description:
Several minor DRY / dead-code issues in crest_http_client.cr:
- extract_domain(url) private method just delegates to @validator.extract_domain — call site in handle_redirects should call @validator directly
- transition_domain is called conditionally on domain != target_domain, but record_success is then called unconditionally afterwards on the original domain in perform_request — the conditional in transition_domain adds no value
- validate_redirect_domain: target_domain computed but only the source_domain is used in allow_redirect? — parameter is dead
- handle_redirects returns convert_response(response) when remaining <= 1, but it has already mutated circuit_breaker / recorded_success on the target domain, so a redirect to the final destination will record twice
- handle_error's case has trailing alignment whitespace
- Magic number 10_000 for @@dns_max_entries should be a named constant
title: Remove dead/redundant code in redirect handling
